note: The site's hero/footer bookend backdrop. Deliberately CONTENTLESS: one ambient shader field, no text, no blocks, no cuts, no stings. Every other clip in assets/ demonstrates a capability, which means every other clip has words in it, and words behind a headline read as drifting smudges. This one exists only to be a surface. The page blurs it, multiplies it over cobalt and crops it, so it is judged on luminance movement alone, never on legibility. If you add a layer with copy in it, you have broken the one thing this file is for.
